evidence_tree.contamination_note: A first scratch directory at .../scratchpad/oracle-C6 was NOT fresh: it already held data/ and docs/ from an earlier run (mtime 19:34) plus a root-level file 'syndra.txt' (20043 bytes, mtime 20:15). 'git ls-tree --name-only HEAD' shows no 'syndra.txt' at the repo root, and the mandated archive command exports only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md, so that file could not have come from the export. It was discarded unread and a genuinely fresh tree (oracle-C6-fresh) was built and used for every quotation below.

independent_computation.step_1_identify_the_leaf: cast_timeline[5] is the 6th cast event. With four abilities and Q/W having castTime 'none' (0 s), the opening block fills indices 0-3 at t = 0, 0, 0, 0.25 (E occupies 0->0.25, so R starts at 0.25). Indices 4 and 5 are therefore the first two recasts, ordered by effective cooldown.
independent_computation.step_2_effective_cooldowns: cd' = cd*100/(100+AH) applied to the sourced bases Q=7, W=8, E=15, R=80 (R rank 3).

step_3_solve_for_the_haste_each_value_im.old_7.27: 8 * 100/(100+AH) = 7.2727... => AH = 10. Exactly 800/110 = 7.272727..., which rounds to the stored 7.27. No other sourced base (7, 15, 80) can produce 7.2727 at any non-negative haste (7 would need AH = -3.75).

step_4_full_timeline_reconstruction.note: One scheduler, one cast order, one parameter changed. Index 5 is Force of Will's second cast in BOTH baselines; only the ability haste fed to cd' differs (10 vs 60). A brute-force sweep over AH in {0..120 step 5}, R ranks 1-3, four Q-haste policies, both cast-time conventions and every cast order of length 3-6 found NO configuration that yields 7.2727 at AH = 60, and none that yields 5.0 at AH = 10: the leaf value is a pure function of the haste applied to W.

independent_computation.step_5_which_haste_is_the_scenario_s: The scenario is named 'syndra_custom_order_60'. 60 is not a level (the level cap is 20 per CLAUDE.md) and cannot be an ability rank; as an ability-haste knob it reproduces the new value exactly (8*100/160 = 5.0). The old value's implied AH = 10 matches no scenario knob - the only '10' anywhere in Syndra's sourced kit is R's rank-1 passive haste, which the cached R text scopes to Dark Sphere alone ('Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced...'), never to Force of Will, and at a level-18 golden fixture R is rank 3 (30) anyway. So 10 is not a defensible haste for W's cooldown under any reading of the cached data, while 60 is exactly the scenario's own number.

caveat_recorded_but_not_verdict_bearing.observation: data/champions.json flags Syndra Q with affectedByCdr: false (a genuine static-cooldown marker - the same flag carries Yasuo Q, Yone Q, Zeri Q, Jinx Q, Gangplank E, Karthus E and 49 other real static-cooldown abilities, 55 of 741 total, so it is not a parser artifact), and R's passive grants Dark Sphere 10/20/30 ability haste. A fully faithful Q would therefore recast at 7*100/(100+30) = 5.3846 s at R rank 3, not at the 4.375 s (7*100/160) implied by the reconstructed timeline.
caveat_recorded_but_not_verdict_bearing.impact_on_this_leaf: None for the value itself: index 5 is W, and W is affectedByCdr: true, so its cooldown is 8*100/160 = 5.0 regardless of how Q is treated. If the engine ever starts honouring Q's static flag, Q's cast at index 4 moves from 4.375 to 5.3846 and the ORDER of indices 4/5 flips - the 5.0 entry would then land at index 4. That is a separate, still-open question about Dark Sphere, flagged here as an aside; it does not make 7.27 correct.
caveat_recorded_but_not_verdict_bearing.aside: If Syndra's Q static cooldown + R-passive haste is not modelled, Syndra's Q uptime is currently overstated at high ability haste (4.375 s vs the sourced 5.3846 s at R3), and understated below level 6 (7.0 s sourced). Worth a look independently of this leaf.

verdict_rationale: 5.0 s is exactly the sourced Force of Will rank-5 cooldown (8 s, affectedByCdr true) under the scenario's own 60 ability haste, via the documented exact formula cd' = cd*100/(100+AH). 7.27 s is 800/110, i.e. the same cooldown with only 10 ability haste applied - a haste value no cached source supplies for Force of Will. The new baseline value is correct.
